title: Landhauler
body:
The landhauler is a vehicle that can be bought from Alan's autologistics for $50,000. It has a top speed of 75 studs per second going both forward and backward on flat land.

It features two wheels in the front and four more in the back. It also has one drivers seat paired with a passenger's seat right next to it, with two windowed doors on each side and a big windshield on the front.

It also has a sort of bin on the back of it that allows for easy transportation of various materials such as wood and ores. The bin has two options for interaction of it which are lowering and raising the bin. When the bin is fully raised, it temporarily removes the back wall of the bin so the materials inside flow out, Effectively working as a dump truck.

The description of the landhauler ingame is as follows:

"This dump of a truck can carry loads of objects, like ores, and dump them! Comes with a special ability to raise and lower the bin, where the back will automatically open."

Type: Structures Cost: $50,000
